question: Which complaint types with more than 3000 total requests from 2011 to 2020 show the strongest positive and negative Pearson correlations with the daily average wind speed measured at station 744860 (JFK Airport), based on daily complaint proportions (the ratio of type-specific complaints to total daily complaints)? Please provide the complaint types and their correlation coefficients, rounded to four decimal places.

wind_data AS (
  SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE) AS date, SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) AS wdsp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2011` WHERE stn = '744860' AND wban = '94789' AND SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) != 999.9
  UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2012` WHERE stn = '744860' AND wban = '94789' AND SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) != 999.9
  UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2013` WHERE stn = '744860' AND wban = '94789' AND SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) != 999.9
  UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2014` WHERE stn = '744860' AND wban = '94789' AND SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) != 999.9
  UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2015` WHERE stn = '744860' AND wban = '94789' AND SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) != 999.9
  UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2016` WHERE stn = '744860' AND wban = '94789' AND SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) != 999.9
  UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2017` WHERE stn = '744860' AND wban = '94789' AND SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) != 999.9
  UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2018` WHERE stn = '744860' AND wban = '94789' AND SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) != 999.9
  UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2019` WHERE stn = '744860' AND wban = '94789' AND SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) != 999.9
  UNION ALL SELECT date, SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2020` WHERE stn = '744860' AND wban = '94789' AND SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) != 999.9
),
daily_totals AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(DATE FROM created_date) AS complaint_date, COUNT(*) AS total_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_date) BETWEEN 2011 AND 2020
  GROUP BY EXTRACT(DATE FROM created_date)
),
daily_by_type AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(DATE FROM created_date) AS complaint_date, complaint_type, COUNT(*) AS type_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_date) BETWEEN 2011 AND 2020
  GROUP BY EXTRACT(DATE FROM created_date), complaint_type
),
qualifying_types AS (
  SELECT complaint_type FROM daily_by_type GROUP BY complaint_type HAVING SUM(type_count) > 3000
),
daily_proportions AS (
  SELECT d.complaint_date, d.complaint_type,
    CAST(d.type_count AS FLOAT64) / CAST(t.total_count AS FLOAT64) AS daily_proportion,
    w.wdsp AS wind_speed
  FROM daily_by_type d
  JOIN daily_totals t ON d.complaint_date = t.complaint_date
  JOIN qualifying_types q ON d.complaint_type = q.complaint_type
  JOIN wind_data w ON d.complaint_date = w.date
),
corr_data AS (
  SELECT complaint_type,
    COUNT(*) AS n,
    SUM(daily_proportion) AS sum_x,
    SUM(wind_speed) AS sum_y,
    SUM(daily_proportion * daily_proportion) AS sum_x2,
    SUM(wind_speed * wind_speed) AS sum_y2,
    SUM(daily_proportion * wind_speed) AS sum_xy
  FROM daily_proportions
  GROUP BY complaint_type
)
SELECT 
  complaint_type,
  ROUND(
    (n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) / 
    NULLIF(SQRT((n * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x) * (n * sum_y2 - sum_y * sum_y)), 0),
    4
  ) AS pearson_correlation
FROM corr_data
WHERE n > 1
ORDER BY ABS((n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) / NULLIF(SQRT((n * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x) * (n * sum_y2 - sum_y * sum_y)), 0)) DESC
LIMIT 2
